sentences.text: Researchers built a web-based system called NIMP to manage how human brain tissue is turned into digital data while keeping a complete record of every step. The platform combines donor registration, anatomical labeling, tissue distribution, sequencing steps, quality checks, and data storage into one unified system.
The authors state that this system offers a scalable and reusable way to manage resources with full history records and to generate data that is easy to find and share for future large projects.
